Definition: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pour, pour out, spill; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to pour, pour out; 1a2) to shed (blood); 1a3) to pour out (anger or heart) (fig); 1b) (Niphal) to be poured out, be shed; 1c) (Pual) to be poured out, be shed; 1d) (Hithpael); 1d1) to be poured out; 1d2) to pour out oneself
